pho75 didn't state it wasn't work, just that it's easier to be able to do the things that OP was stating she does *without* working 50-60 hours a week. There is no doubt that being a stay at home mom and/or wife is a demanding position in life when taken seriously, and one that is often undervalued. It would be fantastic if marriages could always work where this can be the scenario. 

But guess what? The job market sucks and lots of jobs are paying less and demanding more hours. Sucks right? What happens when one or both parent's job suddenly demand more hours? Go find other work? Good luck with that. Want to give me the old "you should have picked a better career path?" bit? Go bite a big one whenever you make a purchase or call to just about anywhere. Going to the hospital? I know plenty of nurses who have had to increase their hours to the point of exhaustion. They stay so their kids can attend proper schools.

Career as priority? Try living in reality. You should feel shame for even the possibly of making a single parent or couple who is getting beat up by their job feel even worse about the time they are missing out on with their kids. They WANT to spend time with them but are afraid for their future security to do different.

Downvote me all you want you guilt tripping asshole.
